_comment: Per-dataset column mapping (raw column -> canonical field). All four verified 2026-08-20 against the actual downloaded files (see inspect_columns.py). fitness_exercises_dataset is JSON, not CSV - handled by a separate loader path in ingest_exercise_catalog.py.

exercises_dataset._note: secondaryMuscles/instructions are stored as Python-list-literal strings (e.g. "['obliques']") not separator-joined - handled by a literal-list parser, not the generic splitter.

fitness_exercises_dataset._note: JSON list of {exerciseId, name, gifUrl, targetMuscles: [...], bodyParts: [...], equipments: [...], secondaryMuscles: [...]}. Only a ~30-exercise sample in this Kaggle release (folder is literally named exercisedb_v1_sample), not the full ExerciseDB catalog - still a useful cross-reference source, just don't expect it to dominate row count.
